dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Distinct thin-walled light-colored 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are visible against a dark substrate. The edges exhibit high-contrast, sharp transitions from the dark exterior to a narrow, high-intensity perimeter with a dark interior center, particularly in the mid-lateral region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of amorphous light-intensity clusters localized near the anterior neck region and along the lower lateral-ventral boundary, lacking the internal dark gradient seen in the annular structures.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent circular rings in the mid-section form an obtuse, scalene triangle oriented horizontally along the lateral axis.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly repetitive, reticulated mesh-like pattern covering the dorsal surface, creating a continuous network of light-colored geometric cells.
